title: Convert Doubly Linked List to Array I
description:
You are given the `head` of a **doubly linked list**, which contains nodes that have a next pointer and a previous pointer.

Return an integer array which contains the elements of the linked list **in order**.
constraints: The number of nodes in the given list is in the range [1, 50].
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Convert Doubly Linked List to Array I.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
